recommended_layout.README.md: Single public entry point: thesis, quick start, architecture map, validation status, and links to canonical subtrees.
recommended_layout.LICENSE: Choose a single explicit license after reviewing the source repositories; preserve source notices in provenance.
recommended_layout.docs/architecture/: System maps, dependency graph, terminology, decision records, and boundaries between conceptual and executable layers.
recommended_layout.docs/protocols/: Phoenix, convergence, narrative, coherence, and orchestration protocols after deduplication and cross-link repair.
recommended_layout.docs/origin/: Chronology, phone-first and zero-budget development story, authorship notes, and source provenance.
recommended_layout.docs/claims-and-evidence/: Claims ledger separating verified tests, self-reported conditions, design hypotheses, and unverified performance claims.
recommended_layout.benchmarks/arc-agi/: ARC-AGI data and browser interface, isolated from production runtime code.
recommended_layout.services/agent-runtime/: Agent runtime and tool interfaces from agents, with clear dependency manifests and tests.
recommended_layout.services/omninet/: OmniNet routing and network components, isolated behind explicit interfaces.
recommended_layout.apps/portal/: Portal and interface code from sovereign-agsi-portal, with private/secrets boundaries documented.
recommended_layout.archive/scrolls/: Grossian Scrolls and narrative archive as an explicit archive, not mixed into runtime code.
recommended_layout.archive/source-repositories/: Immutable provenance manifests and optional git subtree references; no silent destructive deletion.
recommended_layout.scripts/: Build, import, reference validation, test, and release scripts.
recommended_layout.tests/: Cross-package smoke tests, contract tests, and provenance/claim checks.

merge_risks: Multiple repositories contain overlapping Phoenix, SSI, AGSI, OmniNet, convergence, or portal concepts; preserve provenance and choose canonical implementations explicitly.
The repositories use different branches and commit histories; a monorepo import should preserve source commit metadata and avoid claiming a single continuous history unless verified.
Only 6 of 17 repositories showed filename-level test evidence in the audit; cross-package tests must be added before declaring the unified repository production-ready.
The audit found one private repository; access controls and secret handling must be preserved during any import or publication step.
ARC-AGI contains a large dataset and browser interface and should remain isolated from runtime services and build pipelines.
A single top-level license cannot be selected automatically from heterogeneous sources; legal review is required before publishing a final license.

recommended_policy.integration_mode: non-destructive monorepo import with provenance manifests and explicit canonicalization
recommended_policy.source_visibility: do not publish private source content until the user explicitly approves its visibility
recommended_policy.review_gate: no repository creation, push, deletion, archival, or visibility change before user approval of the proposal
